assessment: Anxiety change was −5.70 (95% CI −7.26 to −4.14) versus −0.65 (−2.33 to 1.03). The combined treatment and migraine population prevent inference for cold-pressed oil alone in Parkinson disease.

fit: baked whole flaxseed and constipation in type 2 diabetes
assessment: The 12-week global constipation symptom improvement favors flaxseed cookies over placebo cookies, 2.46 versus 0.41 points (p=.008). The tested seed food and comorbidity differ from culinary flaxseed oil and Parkinson constipation.

fit: seed flour and lactulose comparison in functional constipation
assessment: The four-week median Wexner score reduction was 7 versus 5 points (between-arm p=.017). This active comparison concerns flaxseed flour, so it supplies no result for the isolated oil.
